settings.about: A collection of 20th-century banknotes found in museum archives and online. From the last notes of fallen empires to the first currencies of newly independent nations, each bill is a small record of its time: its art, politics and ambitions printed on paper. Browse the catalogue and see how a hundred years of history passed from hand to hand.
